resume.text:
Alex Morgan
Chicago, IL • alex.morgan@example.com • github.com/alexmorgan-dev

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack developer with 4 years of experience building web applications with React, Node.js and SQL databases, from design through deployment and support.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS
Frontend: React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Jest, React Testing Library
Backend: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, JWT authentication
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
Cloud and tools: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), Docker, GitHub Actions, Jira

WORK EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Northwind Logistics, Chicago, IL (Mar 2023 - Present)
• Built a shipment tracking dashboard in React and TypeScript used by 300 dispatchers, replacing three spreadsheet-based reports.
• Designed REST APIs in Node.js and Express for orders, carriers and delivery events, with request validation and role-based access.
• Modeled order and shipment data in PostgreSQL and added indexes that cut the slowest report query from 9 seconds to under 1 second.
• Set up GitHub Actions pipelines that run tests and deploy Docker containers to AWS EC2 on every merge to main.
• Added Redis caching for carrier rate lookups, reducing calls to a paid third-party API by about 40 percent.
• Reviewed pull requests and wrote onboarding guides for two new team members.

Junior Web Developer, Lakeview Health Partners, Evanston, IL (Jun 2021 - Feb 2023)
• Developed patient appointment scheduling screens in React with form validation and accessible components.
• Built Express endpoints for appointments and reminders, storing data in MySQL.
• Followed HIPAA access-control rules when handling patient records and audit logs.
• Wrote unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, raising coverage of the scheduling module to 80 percent.
• Fixed production bugs reported by clinic staff and documented each fix in Jira.

PROJECTS
Recipe Finder: a React app that searches recipes by ingredient using a public API, with saved favorites in MongoDB.
Budget Bot: a Python script that reads bank CSV files and sends a weekly spending summary by email.

EDUCATION
B.S. in Computer Science, University of Illinois Chicago, 2021

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer - Brightline Health (Remote, US)

Brightline Health builds care-coordination software used by 400+ clinics. We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our Patient Platform team.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain features across our React/TypeScript front end and Node.js services
- Design REST and GraphQL APIs used by web and mobile clients
- Model data in PostgreSQL and tune slow queries
- Deploy and operate services on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes
- Mentor junior engineers and take part in code reviews

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of professional software development experience
- Strong experience with React and TypeScript
- Experience building backend services with Node.js
- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
- Familiarity with HIPAA or other healthcare compliance requirements
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- GraphQL
- Experience mentoring other engineers

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role.

jobs.coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Senior Full Stack Engineer position on the Patient Platform team at Brightline Health. My experience building full‑stack web applications aligns with the technical needs of the role.

I built a shipment tracking dashboard in React and TypeScript that served 300 dispatchers, replacing three spreadsheet‑based reports. I also designed REST APIs in Node.js and Express with request validation and role‑based access, and modeled order and shipment data in PostgreSQL, adding indexes that reduced the slowest report query from 9 seconds to under 1 second. In addition, I followed HIPAA access‑control rules when handling patient records and audit logs, set up GitHub Actions pipelines for testing and Docker deployment to AWS EC2, and reviewed pull requests while writing onboarding guides for new team members.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background can contribute to Brightline Health’s patient platform.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React)
jobs.description:
Frontend Developer (React) - Pinecrest Learning, Remote (US)

Pinecrest Learning makes reading apps for elementary schools. We're hiring a Frontend Developer to build accessible, fast learning experiences for students and teachers.

What you'll do
- Build new features in React and TypeScript
- Turn Figma designs into accessible, responsive components
- Write tests with Jest and React Testing Library
- Work with our Node.js API team on data contracts
- Improve page load performance on low-end school devices

You have
- 2+ years building production React applications
- Strong TypeScript skills
- Experience with accessibility (WCAG 2.1)
- Experience with automated testing
- Comfort working with REST APIs

Bonus
- Next.js
- Experience in education technology
- Storybook or a design system

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot)
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot) - Fernway Payments, Austin, TX (Hybrid)

Fernway Payments processes card and ACH payments for 20,000 small businesses. Our Platform team builds the services behind payouts, refunds and merchant onboarding.

Responsibilities
- Design and build Java microservices with Spring Boot
- Build event-driven workflows with Apache Kafka
- Own PostgreSQL schemas and write efficient SQL
- Write unit and integration tests with JUnit
- Run services on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes
- Participate in on-call rotation for production systems

Requirements
- 3+ years of backend development experience
- Strong Java and Spring Boot skills
- Experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL
- Experience designing REST APIs
- Experience with message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ

Preferred
- Payments or fintech experience
- Kubernetes
- Observability tools such as Datadog or Grafana

We sponsor H-1B visas for qualified candidates.
